verdict.rationale: Foreloop offers a lightweight feedback widget ('one tag' script, or npm package) that routes submissions to a project or org feedback list, and a widget key scoped only to submitting feedback — this lowers technical barriers but still requires embedding a script tag or npm-installing a package into the site, which is a technical step rather than a fully PM-managed, no-code portal setup, and there's no evidence of a standalone hosted feedback page a PM can spin up alone. Missing for 10: a no-code hosted portal page/URL configurable purely via UI, and explicit confirmation that non-engineers can insert the widget without developer involvement (e.g., via tag manager).
